detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same 24-year-old Chinese man throughout, same face, same short black hair, same faded pale-blue shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm over dark grey work trousers. The camera holds a static shot. His left hand rotates the bottle cap the rest of the way until it seats with a click; as the last words leave him his chin pushes forward once and his gaze stays locked off to the left of frame. The speaker (S1) says, low and even, each word set down separately, <d>[Chinese] 除了他，没人会这么针对我。</d> a plastic cap seating with a click, then wind.
